task.problem: Published TASK-164 closed P6.1a by freezing deterministic retrieval-quality metrics over TASK-122 lexical hits and TASK-129 GroundedAnswer citations. P6.1 cannot close until those metrics are exercised against real acquired marketplace evidence. Re-running live discovery on every benchmark execution would make the baseline drift with marketplace ranking, availability, CAPTCHA, and listing mutation; automatically deriving relevance labels from whatever evidence happens to be retrieved would also violate TASK-164's Human-authored benchmark contract. TASK-165 therefore separates one implementation-time real capture from repeatable offline benchmark execution: three exact Human search intents are fixed in this TASK, the corresponding real persisted source packs are frozen as test fixtures without semantic rewriting, Human relevance labels are fixed by acquisition cohort rather than by retrieval outcome, and all baseline metrics are recomputed deterministically from those frozen artifacts on every verification run.
